purpose: Create a larger collision-audited historical universe for frozen-B1a regime/composition validation after the four exposed 100-race batches, without recycling DEV2000 as untouched evidence.
selection_rule: The five meeting IDs above are frozen before any target result scoring for this experiment.
For each fixed meeting, enumerate day indices 01,02,03,04 and race numbers 01..12 in fixed listed-meeting/day/race order.
Attempt PRE racecard parsing only during selection. A candidate enters the universe iff all mandatory frozen-B1a PRE fields parse successfully under the existing fail-closed parser.
Retain every PRE-complete candidate from the fixed universe; do not stop at a favorable count, replace after results, or delete unfavorable races.

Before prediction/result scoring, fail closed if any fixed meeting collides with the seed/temporal meeting set, batch3 independent-meeting set, batch4 coverage-balanced set, or explicitly known smaller scored/prospective historical meetings.

DEV2000 is not queried as new validation data. The fixed 2026-08/09 meeting dates are temporally outside the exposed DEV2000 2026-03-01 through 2026-04-10 universe window and are additionally treated as distinct by meeting identity.
Require at least 100 successfully frozen races across at least four of the five fixed meetings; otherwise fail closed before dedicated result scoring and do not change the rule after seeing outcomes.
Freeze PRE inputs, B1a probabilities/rankings, and preregistered PRE-only regime variables for the complete selected universe before dedicated result-page scoring.
After the prediction lock exists, score every frozen race for which the official result parser succeeds; any result-fetch/parser failure is retained explicitly and is not silently substituted.
No odds or payout data are required or used for this probability/ranking experiment.

known_collision_boundaries.dev2000: EXPOSED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; 2026-03-01 through 2026-04-10; never reused as new untouched validation
